key_points.text: My guest this week is Catherine Collins, who is the head of the Sustainable Investments.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest this week is Catherine Collins, who is the head of the Sustainable Investments, a portfolio manager on two of Putnam's sustainable investing funds, and the author of the book The Nature of Investing, Resilient Investment Strategies Through Biomimicry.

thesis: The speaker argues that the finance industry has historically decoupled investment mechanics from their broader impacts on society, the economy, and the world by focusing narrowly on a pure utility function of money in and money out. ESG and biomimicry frameworks are presented as necessary tools to reintegrate these neglected factors, such as human well-being and climate, into the investment process to achieve a more complete view.
